fusions.name: Salmon Toss
fusions.desc: Hurls a salmon that deals 14 damage, up to 1.6 times at maximum range, and knocks the target back 3 tiles. Each hit has a 50% chance of leaving the target [Soaked] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Wet Slap
fusions.desc: A slap that deals 4 damage and leaves the target 6% easier to wound for 4 seconds. Each hit has a 30% chance of leaving the target [Soaked] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Slip the Line
fusions.desc: Increases your dodge chance by 25% for 12 seconds and pulls up to 3 enemies within 5 tiles onto you for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Slick Coat
fusions.desc: Each time you inflict a condition on an enemy, you regain 2 health a second for 5 seconds. Once every 10 seconds. Your dodge chance rises by 6%.
